title: The Geometry of Coexistence
subtitle: Why multi-task reinforcement learning updates can be merged

paper.title: SFT Conflicts, RL Coexists: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Multi-Task Learning for LLMs
paper.popularityEvidence: #1 Paper of the day with 42 upvotes on the Aug 10 Hugging Face Daily Papers page

chapters.title: One Model, Four Moving Capabilities
chapters.blurb: Watch the same four-task checkpoint collapse under multi-stage supervision and rise under multi-stage reinforcement learning.

chapters.title: Measure the Update Geometry
chapters.blurb: Reconstruct task deltas, compare their norms and cosines, and see why small sparse updates leave room between capabilities.

chapters.title: Advantage Leaves Only the Residual
chapters.blurb: Follow sixteen on-policy rollouts through advantage normalization until the shared direction cancels and only variance remains.

chapters.title: Train Apart, Merge Once
chapters.blurb: Fork task jobs from one base model, merge their updates with the repository tools, and evaluate what each capability retains.
